findings: gate is a CONSISTENCY gate, not an authentication gate: with no keys, a deliberate forger who recomputes a fully consistent receipt is ACCEPTED (BP1). Adversarial integrity needs keys (SIG-1, Casey-gated).
git cannot enforce message-embedded receipts from pre-commit (COMMIT_EDITMSG is absent or STALE — verified empirically). Enforcement must be at commit-msg. Gate installed at both.

FNV-1a-64 is genuinely collidable at ~2^28 work (3/3 rounds, all independently verified) vs the 2^32 generic birthday bound; mean avalanche 28.07/32 bits, min 6. Do NOT use FNV-64 as an adversarial cell address; sha256 pinned.
